csv_project_name: Engineering Svc For Woodard Canyon Trail Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Homer, Alaska is requesting proposals from qualified trail design professionals for the conceptual design of a low-impact looped trail above Karen Hornaday Park. The future trail will be named the Woodard Canyon Trail. This trail will be incorporated with the proposed Woodard Canyon Trail that will utilize the existing roadbed. The project consists of furnishing all labor, materials, equipment, tools, supervision, and other facilities necessary for the Conceptual Design of a looped trail system. The City desires a scenic and meandering wilderness style Level 1 trail as defined in the City of Homer s Design Criteria Manual for Trails.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Geology, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Groundwater/Hydrogeology, Stormwater
